decision_reason: Amsterdam/signals is the public Django backend/API and case-management codebase for Signalen. The official Dutch OSS Register identifies Signalen as an Amsterdam initiative and reports its municipal production scale; Amsterdam's current city service page provides live operational evidence. The backend's own MPL-2.0 grant and 2018 first license-bearing commit are verified. Treat this as one Signalen product family with the separately reviewed frontend, not as a separate product for every fork/component.

government_provenance.note: The official Dutch OSS Register identifies Gemeente Amsterdam as the owner of the Signalen project, says it was developed at Amsterdam's initiative, and links the canonical Amsterdam frontend. Amsterdam/signals' README identifies that frontend as its associated web interface; its application-design docs say the backend was developed for and by the municipality.

public_source.note: The public repository contains the Django application/API, tests, Docker Compose development/deployment configuration, and technical docs; source is readable without credentials. Its docs identify the separately maintained browser frontend.

eligible_license.note: Inspected the actual LICENSE text: Mozilla Public License 2.0. Git history shows the first LICENSE-bearing commit on 2018-06-06: https://github.com/Amsterdam/signals/commit/8167a338f399b371b3680b8caee47b2b431467f1. This determines the grant for this repository only, not every linked Signalen stack component.

primary_evidence.note: The official register's Signalen entry reports approximately 300,000 annual Amsterdam public-space reports and more than 1,400 municipal staff working with the system, and says the open-source software can be used by other governments. Amsterdam's city page links the live resident reporting service: https://www.amsterdam.nl/leefomgeving/een-melding-doen/.

product_identity: Signalen municipal reporting and case-management system (this repository supplies the Django backend/API)
agency: Municipality of Amsterdam (Gemeente Amsterdam; project origin and steward)
license: MPL-2.0 (Amsterdam/signals backend repository only; not a blanket license claim for linked components)
family_note: Treat Signalen as one product family with the separately reviewed Signalen/frontend web application. GitHub labels Signalen/backend as a fork of Amsterdam/signals, so it is not a distinct backend product. Other auxiliary repositories (including deployment charts/classification/mapserver) are separate codebases and are not licensed by this repository's LICENSE; do not infer their license scope from this review.
status_note: This repository is the backend/API, not the citizen-facing frontend. The official register and live city service establish product use; the first defensible public licensed-source year is 2018 based on the LICENSE-bearing commit dated 2018-06-06.
